description_compelling: Office is converted into income — kickbacks, no-bid contracts, ghost employees, capital flight by senior officials — at a scale that distorts the public budget. Executive-corruption indices, control-of-corruption scores, and neopatrimonialism measures climb together over many years. Concentrated in resource-rich autocracies and weak-institution democracies.
